tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a botanical simulation illustration for an agricultural software plant card.
Create one high-quality landscape image in approximately 3:2 aspect ratio (1536 by 1024 composition). Show a single soybean plant, Glycine max, on a small oval patch of natural brown soil, isolated against a clean warm-white/off-white studio background. The whole plant, stem base and soil patch are fully visible with generous margins, centered composition, straight-on slightly elevated three-quarter viewpoint. Polished scientific 3D illustration with realistic botanical structure and soft tactile detail, natural leaf colors and subtle leaf veins, soft diffuse studio light, restrained natural shadows. It must be clearly an illustrative synthetic botanical model, not a field photograph. Maintain an uncluttered, consistent visual language suitable for a small white UI card.
No text, letters, captions, numbers, diagnostic boxes, arrows, logos, watermarks, chart, grid or UI. No multiple plants, no landscape, no pot, no human, no equipment, no detached leaf detail unless explicitly requested below.
Stage: newly established soybean seedling. A short fresh green upright stem, two rounded cotyledons close to its base, a pair of young simple leaves, and the first developing trifoliate leaf at the top. Compact delicate young plant, clearly early growth. No flowers, pods, leaf spots or wilt.
